summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: fix observed Planfile update readback failure, verify, publish and merge through independent local Validator. Honor GitHub protected-title sync policy without weakening create identity checks; failed readbacks must not count as successes.

delivery.outcome: Existing GitHub issues retain deliberate titles while valid body updates verify successfully; failed readbacks count only as failed.
nonGoals: No automatic issue renaming or skipped create identity verification.

architecture.decision: Declare existing GitHub title-preservation policy and respect it only for update readback, retaining repository and ID validation and create title matching.

validation.evidence: Regressions cover preserved title updates, strict create rejection and failed counts.
